specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: The direct injection turbo-diesel engine was all new; the NEF (New Engine Family) is square, with a 94.0 mm (3.70 in) bore and stroke, displaces 2,609 cc (2.6 L), and produces 109 hp (81 kW) at 3,800 rpm.

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: The petrol powertrain is 2.0-liter turbocharged, churning out 203 PS (200 hp; 149 kW) power and 370 N⋅m (273 lb⋅ft; 38 kg⋅m) torque.

specs.name: engine_cc
specs.source_sentence: The direct injection turbo-diesel engine was all new; the NEF (New Engine Family) is square, with a 94.0 mm (3.70 in) bore and stroke, displaces 2,609 cc (2.6 L), and produces 109 hp (81 kW) at 3,800 rpm.

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: In addition to the in-house diesel engine, the Scorpio (and Goa) was also offered with Renault's 2-liter F4R petrol engine, producing 116 hp (87 kW) at 5,500 rpm.

specs.name: price
specs.source_sentence: Using this method, the company was able to build from scratch a new vehicle with virtually 100 percent supplier involvement from concept to reality, at a cost of Rs 600 crore ($120 million), including improvements to the plant.
